Israel-Palestine conflict.
# The British Mandate of Palestine saw a surge in Jewish immigration, especially during the Nazi era, leading to the Great Palestine Revolt (1936-39).
# In 1947, the UN Partition Plan (Resolution 181) was proposed to divide the land, but it was rejected by Palestinians, leading to the 1948 Arab-Israeli War and the displacement of 700,000 Palestinians.
# India, under leaders like Mahatma Gandhi and Jawaharlal Nehru, consistently supported the Palestinian cause, viewing it as an anti-colonial struggle.
